context: Evaluates correct handling of a repo with no git remote during a why-investigation.

checklist.name: names_missing_remote_gap
checklist.description: Explicitly states there is no remote and that PR/MR investigation was skipped for that reason.

checklist.name: cites_local_history
checklist.description: Source-control findings are cited to specific local commits or code-graph history entries.

checklist.name: other_categories_attempted
checklist.description: Other available evidence categories are still investigated rather than treating the missing remote as blocking.
